user.title: Connect to SMART Sniffer Agent
user.description: Enter the connection details for the SMART Sniffer agent running on the target machine.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the machine running the SMART Sniffer agent.
data_description.port: HTTP port the agent is listening on (default 9099).
data_description.token: Leave blank if the agent has no auth configured.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the agent for updated SMART data.

data_description.token: Enter the bearer token if auth is enabled on this agent. Leave blank otherwise.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the SMART Sniffer agent. Check the host, port, and token.

abort.already_configured: This SMART Sniffer agent is already configured.

settings.title: SMART Sniffer Settings
settings.description: Adjust connection and polling settings. The host cannot be changed. To change it, remove and re-add the integration.

data.force_update: Write a value on every poll

data_description.port: HTTP port the agent is listening on.
data_description.token: Leave blank if the agent has no auth configured.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll for updated SMART data (in seconds).
data_description.force_update: Enable for InfluxDB, Prometheus, or Grafana. Records a data point on every poll even when the value has not changed. Leave off otherwise to keep the recorder database smaller.

thresholds.title: Choose a drive
thresholds.description: Alert thresholds are set per drive.

threshold_form.title: Thresholds for {drive}
threshold_form.description:
A threshold is the value this drive is allowed to reach before it alerts.
Set a damage count to its current reading to accept damage you already know about and be told only if it gets worse. Wear and spare are meant to move, so leave those near their defaults.
Type the default to clear a threshold.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect with the new settings. Check the port and token.

abort.no_drives: The agent reported no readable drives, so there is nothing to set thresholds on. Check that the agent is reachable and try again.

get_drive_data.name: Get Drive Data
get_drive_data.description: Returns the full cached SMART data for all drives monitored by a SMART Sniffer agent. Useful for passing raw drive health data to an AI for analysis.

config_entry_id.name: Config Entry
config_entry_id.description: The SMART Sniffer agent to query.

agent_outdated.title: SMART Sniffer: Update agent on {hostname} (v{current_version} → v{min_version})
agent_outdated.description:
The agent on **{hostname}** is running version **{current_version}**, but this integration requires at least **{min_version}**.

To update, SSH into the host and run:
```
curl -sSL {install_url} | sudo bash
```
The installer will detect the existing installation and upgrade in place. This repair will clear automatically once the agent reports a compatible version.

remove_live_drive.message: This drive is still being reported by the agent on {host}, so it can't be removed. If the drive has been taken out, it can be removed once the agent stops seeing it. To stop monitoring a drive that's still installed, add it to "exclude_devices" in the agent's config.

remove_agent_device.message: This is the SMART Sniffer agent for {host}. To remove it and all of its drives, delete the {host} entry under Settings, Devices & Services, SMART Sniffer.

remove_agent_offline.message: The agent on {host} isn't responding, so SMART Sniffer can't tell whether this drive is really gone. Try again once the agent is back online.

remove_disk_usage.message: Disk usage for {host} is still being reported. To remove it, remove the "filesystems" section from the agent's config.
